evidence: Our solutions are used in a wide array of environments, end products and applications, such as enterprise and artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, servers and networking and connectivity equipment
Our semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions also enable our customers to build and deploy AI data center infrastructure for their training and inference workloads
Our Ethernet NIC controllers are designed for high-performance virtualization, intelligent flow processing, secure data center connectivity and machine learning
VMware Private AI: This capability, when added to VCF, enables the use of generative AI technologies while addressing data privacy and compliance needs of our customers
Our solutions utilize threat intelligence from a global network of security engineers, threat analyst and researchers, as well as advanced AI and machine learning engines
ai_positioning.summary: AVGO se positionne comme intégrateur d'IA, fournissant des composants semiconducteurs et des solutions logicielles (VMware) optimisés pour les infrastructures de data centers IA, sans développer ses propres modèles IA fondamentaux.
